args.title: Corvid warehouse automation (2026) — combined summary
args.body:
Combined summary of https://blog.corvid.example/2026/warehouse and its companion piece (https://insights.corvid.example/warehouse/companion):

- Autonomous carts drove an 18% increase in pick rates in 2026 warehouse automation deployments.
- Integration took twice as long as planned, signaling implementation timelines are commonly underestimated.
- The biggest saving came from fewer mis-picks, per the companion piece — accuracy gains, not just speed, drove ROI.
